**What remains (CONFIRMED): the rule is not applied to the chain's whole path.** The required change was "Apply the
retrace rule to the chain's whole path, not just the current segment's … If the session reads item 130 (d) otherwise, name
the class notBuilt by number with these cases". The round applies it to an open run's later segments, where a cut-back
candidate exists and routes; every other retrace is routed as before (the S9 routing, `passes(null)`). C-0424 (3) names
that residual as notBuilt #3 with exactly two forms — (1) a corner farther than √2 · `attractCm` from every vertex of the
path it re-enters, (2) a first arm shorter than that bound folded back over by the second (only pprev near). The residual
is wider than those two forms. This seat's oracle over five more seeds of the constructive family (5101, −5203, 5309,
7507, 8101; 10⁴ sequences each) finds well-separated lawful chains, the corner within the bound, committed with a branch,
in three further forms; `insertChain.ts` was instrumented in the mirror only (`s10/mut/instr.py`, stderr lines from
`cutBack`, the run loop's trigger and the passes; restored and SHA-compared after) to read why each fell back:

(A) **The ring's seam — the closing segment is never cut back.** `run()`'s closing segment (`if (run.closed && …)`,
   insertChain.ts:1379 – 1383) calls `routeSegment` without the cut-back branch the open loop has (insertChain.ts:1354 –
   1371). Its retrace is noted (`ctx.reentry`), the watching pass and the back pass both refuse `REENTRY_DETAIL` at the
   commit (insertChain.ts:1402), and the chain is routed as before. Constructed (CONFIRMED, both under S10 and under OFF —
   the round changed nothing here): the S9 arrangement closed with the corner at the seam — L0 `way` (2 030, 2 000) –
   (3 500, 2 000), the mandatory closed chain (2 000, 2 000) → (2 500, 1 600) → (2 500, 2 400) — commits under `invisible`
   with W (2 030, 2 000) of degree 3, the corner V a spur, warnings `W_ATTRACTED ×2 @ (2030, 2000)`, `W_STRETCH_SHARED ×1
   @ (2030, 2000)`, and under a `way` key through the transaction is refused `E_INVARIANT (way, way:c1) branches: a linear
   role forms simple chains or rings (§3.10 role consistency)`. The same for the chain's other direction, for W west of
   V, and with the corner as the ring's last point ((2 500, 1 600) → (2 500, 2 400) → (2 000, 2 000)). V stands 30 cm
   from W, inside the bound; neither named form. In the registered constructive family: seed 8101 generator seed
   1 677 770 628 step 3 (a `ring`, L2 optional, (1 307, 2 631) (1 177, 2 705) (1 053, 2 539) (1 212, 2 435), the seam
   landed on (1 308, 2 650), the branch at (1 281, 2 651) 27 cm from it) and generator seed 1 665 516 641 step 5 (`ring`,
   branch (2 652, 2 644), 27.7 cm from the seam's input point); seed −5203 generator seed 1 720 240 219 step 4 (`ring`,
   mandatory, branch (1 910, 3 946), 25 cm from the seam's input point). For 1 677 770 628 and 1 720 240 219 the replay
   through the transaction is refused `branches` naming the chain's own key (`way:3`, `way:4`).
(B) **A cut back the optional class's precision rules refuse.** The candidate exists within the bound and the cut back's
   route is refused `E_BELOW_MIN_ANGLE` — the as-before route then commits the branch. Seed 5101 generator seed
   1 300 412 224 step 5 (`coincident`, optional, (940, 2 523) (1 850, 1 994) (622, 1 229)): candidate (1 820, 2 012) at
   35.0 cm, `CB r2 … E_BELOW_MIN_ANGLE a corner below minFaceAngle at (1820, 2012)–(622, 1229)`; committed with (1 820,
   2 012) of degree 3; through the transaction refused `(way, way:5) branches`. Seed −5203 generator seed 1 880 377 805
   step 2 (`coincident`, optional): candidate (2 279, 1 267) at 29.0 cm, `CB r1 … E_BELOW_MIN_ANGLE`; committed with a
   branch at (2 279, 1 267).
(C) **A re-entered vertex the chain's own earlier segment placed.** `cutBack` undoes everything since prev's own landing
   (`rollback(ctx, log, prevLand)`, insertChain.ts:1277), which removes the earlier segment's route and every vertex it placed (crossings,
   wedge vertices), and then skips a candidate that is no longer live (`!isVertexLive(p, x)`, insertChain.ts:1279). So a vertex the chain itself
   made is never a cut-to vertex. Seed 8101 generator seed 823 490 252 step 4 (`random`, mandatory, six points): the
   corner (3 723, 2 331) re-enters the wedge-routed vertex (3 691, 2 339) its first segment placed (33.0 cm, within the
   bound); candidates `[[3691, 2339, "33.0"]]`, no route tried, the back pass refuses, the chain commits as before with
   (3 691, 2 339) of degree 3.

Each is lawful input (well-separated simple chains, corner ≥ 60°), committed under a non-linear role with a branch in
the chain's own rows — which item 130 (d) says never commits — and refused `branches` under a linear key: a lawful
refusal class of our own making, neither fixed nor named (C-0424 (3) and N-s10-3 give the class two forms and say "Its
two forms are …"). They are not contrived: (A) – (C) appear 0 – 3 times per 10⁴ constructive sequences at the six seeds read
(none at 20261013; three at 8101) — the rate at which the S9 check's three open cases appeared at seed 20261013. The census cannot see them (B-FUZZ's
`ins` path runs no role consistency and has no simple-run oracle). Rotating a ring's start turns (A) into the open form the round fixes,
so the class is the same rule, not a new design question.

**Required change (inside the item's owns; the session may choose either, per the S9 line's own allowance):** either
(a) apply the cut back to a closed run's closing segment (the seam's input point cut back onto the re-entered vertex, the
run's first segment re-routed from it, as the open loop does), and let `cutBack` take a vertex the earlier segment placed
(read the candidate before the rollback and re-land onto its position, or roll back only to the earlier segment's route
end) and pass an optional class's precision refusal of the cut back on to the next candidate before falling back; or (b)
name the residual exactly: amend C-0424 (3), N-s10-3 and the code comments so notBuilt #3 (M4) is "every retrace of the
chain's own path that the cut back does not route", with its forms listed — the two named plus (3) a closed run's seam
(closing segment), (4) a cut back refused by the optional class's precision rules, (5) a re-entered vertex the chain's own
earlier segment placed — each with a pin in `test/insert/step3-5/` (the constructed seam ring above under `invisible` and
under a `way` key; the constructive cases above replayed from their generator seeds: 1 677 770 628 / 1 665 516 641 at seed
8101, 1 720 240 219 and 1 880 377 805 at −5203, 1 300 412 224 at 5101, 823 490 252 at 8101). Under (a) the census is
re-measured (never rising) and the bands gate re-run; under (b) the pins hold the routed-as-before outcome so a later fix
is a declared shift.
